newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila mill rejects bids for 7,500 T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Manila mill rejects bids for 7,500 T U.S. wheat.

text.p: A Philippine flour miller turned down bids to supply 7,500 tonnes of U.S. western white wheat as a result of high prices, traders said on Thursday.
"The offers were rejected due to high prices. The futures price yesterday was $3.87 a bushel," said one senior trader.
The Manila mill sought tenders late Wednesday for June shipment.
One trader said there were only seven bidders with the market more interested in Egypt which was seeking 400,000 tonnes of wheat.
